A.claim: Unified: if 3 | gcd(x,y,z) or 4 | gcd(x,y,z), then A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions. Packages the 3|x,3|y,3|z family (FLT3) and the 4|x,4|y,z even family (not_fermat_42).

B.claim: At every modulus m, a Beal counterexample forces a in <A>, b in <B>, c in <C> with a+b = c mod m, because {X^x mod m : x >= 3} is exactly the cyclic subgroup <X> when gcd(X,m)=1. Combined with the kernel-verified pairwise coprimality this rejects 77.7% of coprime residue triples at m = 240.
